title: Non-embedded windows do not update their position from initial position on ready
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible: 4.6.1-stable In previous versions too. ### System information Godot v4.6.1.stable - Fedora Linux 42 (Cinnamon) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - PITCAIRN (radeonsi, , ACO, DRM 2.51, 6.18.7-100.fc42.x86_64) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4770 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads) - 31.27 GiB memory ### Issue description Non-embedded windows do not update their position from initial position on ready. Visually, window is in correct position, but there's mismatch in code. For example, `Window.position` will return `(0, 0)`. This leads to visual bugs. In example, `MenuButton` will open popup not under menu button: Issue is fixed if you move window. There are also workaround that can be applied afer showing window: ```gdscript var window_id: int = popup.get_window().get_window_id() var next_position = DisplayServer.window_get_position(window_id) popup.position = next_position ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Disable `Embed Subwindows` in `ProjectSettings`, `display/window/subwindows/embed_subwindows` (required Advanced Settings). 2. Create Windows in scene, set `Initial Position` at `Center of Main Window Screen`. 3. Add `MenuButton` with options. 4. Play. 5. Press `MenuButton`. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [subwindows-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25443609/subwindows-mrp.zip)
